title: CO2 se neend nahi aati, bas stale hawa ka ishaara hai! 😴 #shorts
description:
Class mein neend kyun aati hai? CO2 ka raaz kholte hain!
MH-Z19 sensor asal mein light gin kar CO2 napta hai.
🔬 NDIR sensor andar se
💡 4.26 µm filter ka kamaal
📈 PWM se ppm kaise nikalte hain
⏱️ 3 minute warm-up kyun zaroori
Subscribe karo Echo Lab 3D for more Kholke Dekho builds!
